name: Etsy
description: Run an Etsy shop from any AI agent: create draft listings, edit and publish them, add photos, set price and stock, add tracking to orders, and read listings, orders, receipts and reviews. OAuth2 with automatic refresh-token rotation + x-api-key dual auth.
instructions:
This connector uses the Etsy Open API v3 (developers.etsy.com). You authorize it once, in AnythingMCP; from then on the short-lived access token (1 hour) is renewed automatically, and the refresh token Etsy replaces on every renewal is stored for you.

**Setup**:
1. Register an app at https://www.etsy.com/developers/your-apps → **Create New App**.
2. In the app's settings, add this **callback URL**: `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. Etsy compares it character for character (https, upper/lower case, no trailing slash).
3. Note the app's **Keystring** and **Shared secret**. Enter them as `ETSY_CLIENT_ID` and `ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET`, leave `ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN` empty, and install.
4. Open the connector and click **Authorize with Provider**. Sign in to Etsy, approve, and you land back on the connector page with the tools ready. AnythingMCP runs Etsy's OAuth2 PKCE flow (S256) for you.

**Scopes**: the connector asks for `email_r shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w`: read your account, shops, listings and orders, edit listings, and add tracking to orders. It cannot delete listings. **Connectors installed before October 2026** asked only for the read scopes: to use the write tools, open the connector's OAuth settings, set the scopes above and click **Authorize with Provider** again; until then Etsy answers "Access token lacks scope".

**Already have a refresh token?** You can paste it into `ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN` instead of step 4, if you obtained it yourself through Etsy's OAuth2 PKCE flow for the same app. Connectors set up that way keep working as they are; there is nothing to do. Clicking **Authorize with Provider** on one replaces its token with a new one, and needs the callback URL from step 2.

**Authentication**: the connector attaches both headers on every request:
  - `Authorization: Bearer <auto-refreshed access token>`
  - `x-api-key: ${ETSY_CLIENT_ID}:${ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET}`

Etsy requires the API key on **every** request, OAuth or not, and it must carry the
Keystring AND the Shared secret separated by a colon. The Keystring alone earns a
`403 {"error":"Invalid API key: should be in the format 'keystring:shared_secret'."}`
on every call.

The access token is kept in memory and written back, together with the rotated refresh token, into this connector's own encrypted configuration, so a restart does not lose it. Per Etsy's policy, **refresh tokens rotate on each use**; AnythingMCP stores the new one from every refresh response and re-uses it automatically.

**If a call says the access token could not be renewed**: an Etsy refresh token works once and expires after 90 days unused. Click **Authorize with Provider** on the connector page to get a new one.

**Shop ID**: every account has a shop_id. Get it from `etsy_get_authenticated_user` then `etsy_get_user_shops`.

**Pagination**: `?limit=N&offset=M` (limit max 100).

**Rate limits**: 10k req/24h per app. On 429 back off.

**Creating a listing** takes a few steps, in this order: find the category with `etsy_list_seller_taxonomy`; for a physical item get a shipping profile (`etsy_list_shipping_profiles`), a processing profile (`etsy_list_processing_profiles`) and, outside the EU, a return policy (`etsy_list_return_policies`); create the draft with `etsy_create_listing_draft`; add at least one photo with `etsy_add_listing_image`; publish with `etsy_edit_listing` and `state=active`. Change price or stock with `etsy_read_listing_inventory` then `etsy_set_listing_inventory`, which replaces the whole inventory. Etsy rejects titles with more than three words in capitals and tags longer than 20 characters; a shop on vacation cannot change listings.

**Out of scope here**: deleting listings, payment account, billing, taxonomy edits.

ETSY_CLIENT_ID.label: Keystring
ETSY_CLIENT_ID.help: Etsy developers → Your apps → your app: the Keystring.
ETSY_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: The Keystring is 24 lowercase letters and digits, nothing else (no spaces, no colon).

ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Shared secret
ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same page, the Shared secret next to the Keystring. Paste it on its own: not the Keystring, not "keystring:secret".
ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Shared secret alone: lowercase letters and digits, without the Keystring and without a colon.

ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh token
ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Leave empty: the authorization with Etsy fills it in.

prerequisites: An Etsy app of your own (etsy.com/developers → Create a New App). In the app's settings, add the callback URL `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` (or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself), character for character: without it Etsy refuses the sign-in. A new app can stay *Pending* for a while: until Etsy activates it, sign-in works but every call is refused. Use the **Keystring** and **Shared secret** of an active app.

verifyHints.403: Etsy refused the app keys: the app is not active yet, or the shared secret does not belong to this keystring.

authConfig.scopes: email_r shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w

tools.name: etsy_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Return the user the OAuth token belongs to. Returns user_id, login_name, primary_email.

tools.name: etsy_get_user_shops
tools.description: List shops owned by a user. Returns shop_id, shop_name, currency_code, languages, login_name, last_updated_tsz, listing_active_count. For the connected account, take user_id from etsy_get_authenticated_user first.

user_id.description: Etsy user ID (a positive number): use the user_id returned by etsy_get_authenticated_user.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop
tools.description: Fetch one shop by shop_id with full details (announcement, sale message, etc.).

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_listings_active
tools.description: Public list of a shop's active listings, as any visitor sees them. Etsy caps how far this public view can page (large offsets are refused); to go through all of your own shop's listings, or drafts and inactive ones, use etsy_get_listings_by_shop.

offset.description: Pagination offset (0 = first page). Keep it small: Etsy refuses large offsets on this public endpoint.

sort_order.description: asc, ascending, desc, descending, up, down.

tools.name: etsy_get_listings_by_shop
tools.description: Listings of your own shop by state (active, inactive, sold_out, draft, removed, expired), as the shop owner sees them. Authenticated, so it pages through the whole catalogue, and it can include Inventory and Shipping. Use it rather than etsy_get_shop_listings_active for your own shop.

includes.description: Optional extra data, comma-separated, any of: Shipping, Images, Shop, User, Translations, Inventory, Videos, Personalization, BuyerPrice.

tools.name: etsy_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch one listing by listing_id with full details.

includes.description: Optional extra data, comma-separated, any of: Images, Shop, User, Translations, Videos, Personalization, BuyerPrice. Etsy rejects anything else: inventory (SKUs, quantities, prices per variation) is not available here, and shipping comes with the shop's shipping profiles, not with the listing.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_receipts
tools.description: List orders (receipts) for the shop.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_receipt
tools.description: Fetch one receipt with buyer info, transactions[], shipping address.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_reviews
tools.description: List reviews (transactions with feedback) for the shop.

tools.name: etsy_get_listings_by_shop_section
tools.description: List listings filtered by a shop section.

tools.name: etsy_list_seller_taxonomy
tools.description: The full tree of Etsy seller categories (id, name, children). Use it to find the taxonomy_id for a new listing. The response is large: look for the closest leaf category and keep only its id.

tools.name: etsy_list_taxonomy_properties
tools.description: Properties (size, colour, material…) and their allowed values for one seller category. Needed when an inventory product sets property_values.

tools.name: etsy_list_shipping_profiles
tools.description: The shop's shipping profiles. A physical listing needs one: pass its shipping_profile_id when creating the listing.

tools.name: etsy_list_processing_profiles
tools.description: The shop's processing profiles (Etsy calls them readiness states: ready to ship or made to order, with processing times). A physical listing needs one: pass its readiness_state_id.

tools.name: etsy_list_return_policies
tools.description: The shop's return policies. Publishing a physical listing needs a return_policy_id (not for EU-based shops).

tools.name: etsy_list_shop_sections
tools.description: The shop's sections, to file a listing under one with shop_section_id.

tools.name: etsy_read_listing_inventory
tools.description: Products, prices, quantities and SKUs of a listing, per variation. Read this before etsy_set_listing_inventory: that call replaces the whole inventory.

tools.name: etsy_create_listing_draft
tools.description: Create a listing as a draft (not visible to buyers). A physical listing also needs shipping_profile_id and readiness_state_id; get them, and taxonomy_id, from the etsy_list_* tools first. Add photos with etsy_add_listing_image, then publish with etsy_edit_listing state=active.

price.description: Price in the shop currency, e.g. 24.5.

title.description: Listing title. Letters, numbers, punctuation and spaces only; "&" at most once; no more than 3 words starting with two capital letters.

who_made.description: Who made the item. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

when_made.description: When it was made. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

is_supply.description: true for a craft supply, false for a finished product. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile ID (etsy_list_shipping_profiles). Required for physical listings.

readiness_state_id.description: Processing profile ID (etsy_list_processing_profiles). Required for physical listings.

return_policy_id.description: Return policy ID (etsy_list_return_policies). Required to publish a physical listing, except for EU-based shops.

tags.description: Up to 13 tags, comma-separated. Each tag at most 20 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, - and ' only.

materials.description: Materials, comma-separated. Letters, numbers and spaces only.

should_auto_renew.description: Renew automatically for four months when the listing expires.

is_taxable.description: Apply the shop's tax rates at checkout.

tools.name: etsy_edit_listing
tools.description: Change a listing: title, description, tags, category, shipping, section, or state. state=active publishes a draft (it needs at least one image) and state=inactive takes a listing off the shop. Send only the fields to change, but who_made, when_made and is_supply always together. Price and quantity are not here: use etsy_set_listing_inventory.

state.description: active publishes the listing (draft or inactive); inactive hides it.

title.description: Listing title. Letters, numbers, punctuation and spaces only; "&" at most once; no more than 3 words starting with two capital letters.

who_made.description: Who made the item. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

when_made.description: When it was made. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

is_supply.description: true for a craft supply, false for a finished product. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile ID (etsy_list_shipping_profiles). Required for physical listings.

return_policy_id.description: Return policy ID (etsy_list_return_policies). Required to publish a physical listing, except for EU-based shops.

tags.description: Up to 13 tags, comma-separated. Each tag at most 20 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, - and ' only.

materials.description: Materials, comma-separated. Letters, numbers and spaces only.

should_auto_renew.description: Renew automatically for four months when the listing expires.

is_taxable.description: Apply the shop's tax rates at checkout.

tools.name: etsy_set_listing_inventory
tools.description: Set price, quantity and SKU of a listing, per variation. It REPLACES the whole inventory: read it with etsy_read_listing_inventory, change what you need, and send every product back. In each product keep sku and property_values; in each offering send price as a plain number (amount / divisor from the read, e.g. 2450/100 = 24.5), quantity, is_enabled and readiness_state_id. Etsy refuses an offering without readiness_state_id ("All offerings need readiness state"): keep the one from the read, or take an id from etsy_list_processing_profiles. Unless quantity_on_property lists the property that varies, every product must have the same quantity ("quantity must be consistent across all products"); the same holds for price with price_on_property. Leave out product_id, offering_id, is_deleted and scale_name.

products.description: Every product of the listing, e.g. [{"sku": "MUG-01", "property_values": [], "offerings": [{"price": 24.5, "quantity": 10, "is_enabled": true, "readiness_state_id": 1234567}]}].

price_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the price (as returned by the read).

quantity_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the quantity.

sku_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the SKU.

readiness_state_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the processing profile (readiness state).

tools.name: etsy_add_listing_image
tools.description: Add a photo to a listing from a public image URL (JPG, PNG or GIF, up to 10 MB). rank 1 is the main photo. Etsy allows up to 20 images per listing.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image. AnythingMCP downloads it and uploads it to Etsy.

overwrite.description: Replace the image already at this rank.

tools.name: etsy_add_order_tracking
tools.description: Mark an order (receipt) as shipped with its tracking code. Etsy emails the buyer the shipping notification.

carrier_name.description: Carrier, e.g. dhl, ups, usps, royal-mail, deutsche-post.

note_to_buyer.description: Optional message in the buyer's notification.

send_bcc.description: Also send the notification to the seller.
